counterexample.result: The original two-second background job was cancelled in the no-followup control. Starting a ten-second follow-up cleared its old host timer and allowed its four-second write. Both used the real host worker and SDK with a test-only direct launcher, not outer filesystem isolation.

scope: The private host budget endpoint adds deadline_at_ms, the current task absolute deadline in milliseconds; cancelled grants return null.
Each Linux Bash or native PowerShell process captures the host deadline before launch. Background/promoted processes use it as a kill deadline independently of later root turns.
Ordinary foreground kill bounds are kept if shorter. The original resolved tool spec is not mutated, preserving its foreground wait and background handoff behavior.
Missing, expired, malformed or failed deadline reads refuse command launch rather than falling back to an unbounded background process.
boundaries: The Mac investigation uses the actual worker, official SDK and shell processes with a test-only loader that bypasses the outer isolation launcher. It is not native application isolation acceptance.
Only fixed synthetic commands and a deterministic loopback model are used. No external model requests or reasoning benchmark scores.
This change pins command process lifetimes. It does not redesign per-descendant model-call ownership or prove all overlapping agent budgets are independent.
The Linux SDK preparation fixture is updated for the now-async shell method; syntax is checked locally, but that full isolated fixture was not rerun on this Mac.
The added source and packaged Windows full-SDK case is pending CI. No browser or native GUI regression rerun is claimed for this execution-only change.

replay.instructions: Copy probe files together into a fresh .runtime directory two levels below the repository root, then run overlap-probe.mjs for control and with --followup for the original scenario, or independent-probe.mjs --followup for independent foreground work. Baseline logs used source 5958c8e; current replay uses current source. This direct-launch investigation intentionally has no outer isolation.
